intro: Jobs similar to historians are research and social science careers. By O*NET 31.0 data, the closest are Archivists (79% similar), Sociologists (75%) and Anthropologists and Archeologists (75%). 6 of the 20 are in the same social science group.
shared: These careers share digging into sources, testing an argument against evidence and writing it up for others. O*NET rates complex problem solving at 3.38 out of 5 for historians. Sociology, political science, economics and museum work use the same research habits. Many need a graduate degree, and 12 of the 20 pay more than the $76,750 historian median, mostly in other social sciences.

faq.q: Which jobs like historian pay more?
faq.a: 12 of the 20 similar careers pay more. Political Scientists earn $142,080 (85% more), Economists $124,720 (63% more) and Sociologists $106,030 (38% more), according to BLS May 2025 data. All three need the same graduate level as historians.

faq.q: What jobs like historian need less schooling?
faq.a: 4 of the 20 similar careers usually need less preparation, including Geographers, Intelligence Analysts and Proofreaders and Copy Markers. They use the same research and writing skills and often hire with a bachelor's degree instead of a master's or doctorate.
